messages:
Rina M: Quick thread to lock observability beta scope. Need concrete MVP items and explicit limits.
Owen L: Top asks from pilots: per-route cost CSV, SLO templates, and model-version correlation in traces.
Priya K: FinRegCo + MedAI require pilot-ready features in ~5 weeks. They care about billing reconciliation and rollout correlation.
Ben T: Ops constraints: keep raw spans 7d, aggregated metrics 30d. Full sampling is too costly.
Rina M: Proposed MVP:
- Template dashboards (p50/p95/p99 + error rate + token spend)
- Per-route daily token CSV export, per-model top-N breakdown
- Tracing header for route+model_version, sample-on-error + adaptive sampling for high-QPS routes
- Error grouping by exception signature + model_version, surface 3 redacted examples
Owen L: Header suggestion: X-RW-META: route=/v1/gen;model=rw-7b;ver=2025-02-14 to keep parsing simple. Make model_version an enumerated tag.
Priya K: Pilot acceptance criteria:
- Filter cost by route & model_version
- See p99 spike vs recent model rollout within 24h
- Click error group -> view example requests (PII redacted)
- CSV matching billing window
Ben T: Dev roughs: templates 1.5 sprints, cost pipeline 2 sprints, tracing sampler 1 sprint, error grouping 2 sprints -> ~6.5 sprints. Compression possible by reusing existing widgets.
Dora G: Marketing will call this "sampled traces, limited retention" and needs UI blurb.
infra-bot: deploybot: obs-pipeline canary scheduled 03:15 UTC tomorrow; alert #eng-oncall on failure.
Rina M: Decision: MVP = CSV export + template dashboard + tracing header + error grouping (7d examples). Stretch for pilots: raw-span drilldown + 30d raw exports.
Action items:
- Owen: header spec & sampling defaults (EOW)
- Ben: retention/export S3 plan + redaction (Mon)
- Rina: acceptance checklist + UI disclaimer (Tue)
- Priya: confirm pilot signoffs/legal (Tue)
Owen L: Note: auto-upsample for 30m after model rollout event.
Priya K: Customers ok as long as limits are explicit.
Ben T: +1
Dora G: I'll draft blurb and help doc link.
Rina M: Locking this for CTL review Wednesday. Thanks.
